Hi Dana / Procurement team,

Thanks again for the call this morning — appreciate the clarity on timelines and internal approvals. As discussed, I put together an initial Mutual Action Plan (MAP) focused on vendor onboarding / procurement steps so we can align responsibilities and hit your desired procurement window. Attached: MAP_draft_v1.xlsx and our vendor W-9 (Redwood_W9.pdf).

Quick recap (post-call):
- Goal: Redwood to be an approved vendor in Greenleaf’s procurement system and receive first PO for pilot integration.
- Target close date (proposal): 2026-10-25 (proposal; open to moving based on your internal review).
- Preferred procurement network: you mentioned Coupa but Ariba may also be an option — confirm below.

Draft MAP milestones (high level):
1) Vendor paperwork collected — W-9, vendor registration form, bank letter (Owner: Redwood / Rachel; Due: 2026-10-08)
2) Supplier portal registration (Coupa/Ariba) — Redwood completes vendor profile and uploads docs (Owner: Redwood / Rachel; Due: 2026-10-12)
3) Greenleaf procurement review & vendor validation — compliance checks and legal review (Owner: Greenleaf Procurement; Due: 2026-10-18)
4) PO issuance & payment terms agreed — procurement issues PO (Owner: Greenleaf Procurement; Due: 2026-10-22)
5) Integration kickoff & test invoice (Owner: Redwood + Greenleaf IT); (Due: 2026-10-25)

Dependencies / blockers we flagged on the call:
- Whether Greenleaf will use Coupa or Ariba (this affects portal invites and registration flow).
- Banking verification method (ACH letter vs. voided check).
- Vendor classification and whether additional insurance or security docs are required.

Can you please confirm: 1) which procurement network you prefer (Coupa vs Ariba), 2) best contact for banking info validation, and 3) any additional forms aside from W-9 we should prepare?

Next steps from our side after your confirmation:
- I will upload the MAP_update_v2 to the Drive and push registration in the portal you indicate.
- Karthik will prepare a short SOW sketch for pilot billing cadence if helpful.

Thanks — I’ll stand by to update the MAP and schedule a quick 15-minute alignment if needed.

Best,
Rachel Kim
Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Rachel — good summary. A few clarifications from my side:

- We will most likely use Coupa for this engagement (our vendor admin prefers a single supplier portal), but a small number of vendors are still on Ariba — I will confirm today.
- Procurement will need a completed vendor questionnaire and a bank letter for ACH setup; W-9 is required as you noted.
- Please include a vendor type classification (software / SaaS) on the registration form.

Looping in our procurement lead Marla (procurement@greenleafhealth.com) who will own the validation steps. Marla — can you confirm expected turnaround and whether you need any additional compliance docs (COI, SOC summary, etc.)?

On timing, we are hoping to have vendor registration complete by ~10/20 so we can issue a PO by the end of the month.

Dana Schultz

Hi Rachel / Dana / Karthik,

Thanks for the summary. A few procurement-specific requirements and notes:

- Required docs to start vendor setup: completed vendor registration form, W-9, banking letter on bank letterhead, signed vendor terms (if applicable).
- Lead time: once we receive completed registration and banking materials, our vendor ops team typically issues a supplier ID within 7-10 business days barring any outstanding compliance items.
- We need vendor classification (SaaS) and estimated annual contract value to route to the right approval queue.
- If Redwood intends to use Coupa, please register at https://app.coupa.com/supplier/registration and use company billing name "Redwood Inference, Inc.". If Ariba is required instead we will send an invite.

Please also confirm whether Redwood requires Net 30 or accelerated payment terms; that information helps us configure payment terms in the system.

Best,
